title: India AI Policy: A Framework for Regulation
summary: India does not yet have a comprehensive AI law, relying instead on existing frameworks and sectoral regulations.

keyFacts.claim: Digital India Act proposed as potential framework

whyItMatters: AI regulation will shape India's innovation landscape, startup ecosystem, and governance.
narrative: The government is exploring a Digital India Act as a comprehensive technology framework, while existing laws like IT Act 2000 provide partial coverage for AI-specific issues.

timeline.significance: First formal public consultation on AI regulation

stakeholders.headline: Key Stakeholders
stakeholders.summary: Government and startups are primary stakeholders.

futureOutlook.headline: What Comes Next

scenarios.label: Digital India Act Passage
scenarios.description: May pass within 2-3 legislative sessions if political support holds.

futureOutlook.uncertainty: Political will for comprehensive technology legislation remains uncertain.
